Messages.Author: Vincent
Messages.Body:
Hello,

If I use Antonio's special ability, can I tap the PB: Tshwane to
reduce the cost of the ally?

Antonio d'Erlette
Clan: Tremere antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 5
Disciplines: THA dom for pot
Sabbat: While Antonio is ready, you may spend four transfers to search
your hand or library (shuffle afterward) for a mage ally Antonio could
play. Put that ally in play with life equal to his starting amount
(pay cost as normal).

Powerbase: Tshwane
Type: Master
Requires: laibon
Master: unique location. Requires a ready Laibon.
Tap this location to reduce the cost of a card you play by 1 pool
(this location is not tapped if that card is canceled as it is
played). Any Laibon may steal this location for his or her controller
as a (D) action.

7/7/7 RTR:

"All cost-affecting cards operate no matter how the card is played
("as normal" or otherwise). "

Messages.Author: SteveHarris
Messages.Body:


IANLSJ, but my understanding is yes.
